candidate_windows.window_text: All models are trained on 112 A100 (80G) GPUs with a global batch size of 15M tokens for 13.6K steps (total 200B tokens). The context length is 4096. The maximum learning rate is 2e-4 with 100 warmup steps and the final learning rate decays to 2e-5 with cosine scheduling. We construct three MoE models, 3B (2/16), 3.5B (4/16), and 3.5B (2/8) from LLaMA-2-7B. Here, 3B and 3.5B are the number of activated parameters, and “(2/16)” means 2 out of 16 experts are activated. Similar notations are applied to “(4/16)” and “(2/8)”. Our implementation is based on transformers (Wolf et al., 2020), ZeRO-1 (Rajbhandari et al., 2022), and FlashAttention v2 (Dao, 2023).
